body: Etihad Airways confirmed on October 26 that an Airbus A380-800 had landed in Bangkok for the first time, the carrier's first service to Thailand with the double-decker aircraft. Flight-tracking data showed the 11-year-old aircraft, registered A6-APD, arriving at Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) at 07:20 local time on October 25 after a flight of about five and a half hours from Abu Dhabi Zayed Airport, as the first of a daily A380 service between the two cities.

Etihad announced in February 2026 that the Abu Dhabi–Bangkok route would be operated by its largest aircraft, with the new service starting as the winter travel season begins and aimed at strong travel demand between Thailand, the Middle East and Europe. The chief executive described the Bangkok arrival as an important milestone, said Thailand is an important premium market for the airline, and said deploying the flagship aircraft would add capacity and strengthen connections through Abu Dhabi. The aircraft offers a three-room suite product, nine first-class private suites, 70 business-class seats and 415 economy-class seats.
en.summary: Etihad Airways' Airbus A380-800 has landed in Bangkok for the first time, with the 11-year-old aircraft registered A6-APD arriving on October 25 and marking the carrier's first A380 service to Thailand on a daily Abu Dhabi route.
en.title: Etihad A380 lands in Bangkok for first time, starting daily Abu Dhabi service

body: 阿提哈德航空10月26日確認，空中巴士A380-800已首度飛抵曼谷，成為該公司首度以雙層超大型客機執飛泰國。根據航班追蹤資料，註冊編號A6-APD、機齡11年的客機10月25日當地時間上午7時20分抵達曼谷素萬那普機場，航程約5個半小時，起點為阿布達比扎耶德機場；該公司表示，這是每日阿布達比—曼谷A380航班的首班。
阿提哈德今年2月宣布，阿布達比—曼谷航線將由最大型機型執飛，新服務正值冬季旅遊旺季開始，有助因應泰國、中東與歐洲之間的強勁旅遊需求。執行長表示，曼谷加入A380航網是重要里程碑，泰國是公司的重要高端市場，部署旗艦機型可提升運能並強化經阿布達比轉機的連結性。客艙方面，A380設有空中三房套房產品、9間頭等私人套房、70個商務艙座位與415個經濟艙座位。
zh.summary: 阿提哈德航空空中巴士A380-800首度飛抵曼谷素萬那普機場，註冊編號A6-APD的客機10月25日上午抵達，標誌該公司首度以A380執飛泰國，每日往返阿布達比與曼谷。
zh.title: 阿提哈德A380首度飛抵曼谷，開啟每日阿布達比航線
